answer: Each identity posts a bonded deposit of 500 USDC before it can attest, and every grade it emits carries a pulse tied to that bond. A verifier samples each agent's grades against the knoll of sealed consensus scores; when an agent's grades diverge more than 2 standard deviations from that knoll, its signal gets flagged and the deposit is slashed, seat weight dropping in one epoch. The on-ledger slash trail records every divergence, so farming 10,000 keys means locking 5 million USDC—capital at risk that scales with identity count, unlike free sockpuppet voting.
